test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states the Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) were used for the first time in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian electronic voting machine **(EVM) was **developed **in **1989 **by the **Election Commission of India **in collaboration with **Bharat Electronics Limited **and **Electronics Corporation of India Limited**.
 
• **Electronic voting **was **first **used in **Estonia **during the **October 2005 **local **elections**.
 
• **Estonia **became the **first country **to have **legally binding general elections **using the **Internet **as a means of **casting the vote**.
 
• The **EVMs **were **first used **in **1982 **in the **by-election **to **North Paravur Assembly Constituency **in **Kerala **for a **limited number of polling stations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **EVM **was **introduced **in **Indian elections **between **1998 and 2001**, in **a phased manner**.
 
• An **electronic Voting Machine **( EVM ) is **an electronic device **for **recording votes**.
 
• **An Electronic Voting Machine **consists of **two Units **– a Control Unit and a Balloting Unit – joined by a five-meter cable
